traditional: the Moon sextile Venus: a soft contact. The body, home, and daily needs supports love, money, and pleasure — cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Feelings meet charm and pleasure. Warmth is expressed instinctively, with a strong love of comfort and beauty. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Naturally charming and emotionally generous. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize feeling and connection into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what feeling and connection have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Likable and warm; watch indulgence and shaky money instincts.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and indulgence and vanity go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
